title: Oki Shannon on building an anti-gravity device using Ferris Williams' theory
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Oki Shannon on building an anti-gravity device using Ferris Williams' theory, about unknown at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Shannon is on record saying, "If we were to build an anti-gravitational device, it would be built on the principles involved in William's theory."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a figure connected to Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, named Oki Shannon, is on record about a theory by a man named Ferris Williams. According to Michels, Shannon said that if anyone were to build an anti-gravity device, a machine that cancels the pull of gravity, it would be based on Williams' theory. Michels tells it as a sign that such ideas were taken seriously by insiders.
